chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abi Jameela, from Jabir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There is nothing better from your apparels than the white, therefore clothe your dead ones (in white)'.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended color for shrouding the dead in Islam according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, establishes the preference for white cloth (kafan) for the deceased, linking it to the Prophet’s (SAWW) declaration that it is the most beautiful garment. In Shia jurisprudence, this is classified as mustahabb (recommended) rather than obligatory, reflecting the purity and simplicity associated with the state of death and resurrection. The emphasis on 'white' underscores the spiritual cleanliness and uniformity of believers before Allah, a theme echoed in the Quranic description of the garments of Paradise.
